question.prompt: Points $A$ and $A'$ are reflections of each other across line $l$. The distance from $A$ to $l$ is $4\text{ cm}$. What is the length of $AA'$? (Unit: cm)

solutions.explanation: The axis of reflection perpendicularly bisects $AA'$, so the distance from $A'$ to $l$ is also 4, and $AA'=4+4=8$.
solutions.title: Add the equal distances to the axis
